1.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, 2 tha strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, N Bithynia,
Elect according 2 tha foreknowledge of God tha Father, through sanctification of tha Spirit, 2 obedience N sprinkling of tha blood of Jesus Christ: Grace 2 u, N peace, be multiplied.
Blessed be tha God N Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according 2 his abundant mercy has begotten us again 2 a lively hope by tha resurrection of Jesus Christ from tha dead,
2 an inheritance incorruptible, N undefiled, N dat fades not away, reserved in heaven 4 u,
Who r kept by tha power of God through faith 2 salvation ready 2 be revealed in tha last time.
In which y’all greatly rejoice, though now 4 a season, if need be, y’all r in heaviness through manifold temptations:
Dat tha trial of ur faith, bein much more precious than of gold dat perishes, though it be tried wit fire, might be found 2 praise N honour N glory at tha appearing of Jesus Christ:
Whom havin not seen, y’all love; in whom, though now y’all see him not, yet believin, y’all rejoice wit joy unspeakable N full of glory:
Receivin tha end of ur faith, even tha salvation of ur souls.
Of which salvation tha prophets have enquired N searched diligently, who prophesied of tha grace dat should come 2 u:
Searchin what, or what manner of time tha Spirit of Christ which was in ’em did signify, when it testified beforehand tha sufferings of Christ, N tha glory dat should follow.

2 whom it was revealed, dat not 2 themselves, but 2 us dey did minister tha things, which r now reported 2 u by ’em dat have preached tha gospel 2 u wit tha Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things tha angels desire 2 look in2.
So gird up tha loins of ur mind, be sober, N hope 2 tha end 4 tha grace dat is 2 be brought 2 u at tha revelation of Jesus Christ;
As obedient children, not fashioning y’all according 2 tha former lusts in ur ignorance:
But as he which has called u is holy, so be y’all holy in all manner of conversation;
Because it is written, Be y’all holy; 4 I am holy.
N if y’all call on tha Father, who without respect of persons judges according 2 every man’s work, pass tha time of ur stayin here in fear:
Forasmuch as y’all know dat y’all were not redeemed wit corruptible things, as silver N gold, from ur vain conversation received by tradition from ur fathers;
But wit tha precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish N without spot:
Who for real was foreordained before tha foundation of tha world, but was manifest in dese last times 4 u,
Who by him do believe in God, dat raised him up from tha dead, N gave him glory; dat ur faith N hope might be in God.
Seein y’all have purified ur souls in obeying tha truth through tha Spirit 2 unfeigned love of tha brothers, see dat y’all love one another wit a pure heart fervently:
Bein born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by tha word of God, which lives N abides 4 ever.
4 all flesh is as grass, N all tha glory of man as tha flower of grass. tha grass withers, N tha flower of it falls away:
But tha word of tha Lord endures 4 ever. N dis is tha word which by tha gospel is preached 2 u.

2.text: So laying aside all malice, N all guile, N hypocrisies, N envies, N all evil speakings,
As newborn babes, desire tha sincere milk of tha word, dat y’all may grow by dat:
If so be y’all have tasted dat tha Lord is gracious.
2 whom comin, as 2 a livin stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, N precious,
y’all also, as lively stones, r built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, 2 offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable 2 God by Jesus Christ.
So also it is contained in tha scripture, look, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: N he dat believes on him shall not be confounded.
2 u therefore which believe he is precious: but 2 ’em which be disobedient, tha stone which tha builders disallowed, tha same is made tha head of tha corner,
N a stone of stumblin, N a rock of offence, even 2 ’em which stumble at tha word, bein disobedient: whereunto also dey were appointed.
But y’all r a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; dat y’all should show forth tha praises of him who has called u out of darkness in2 his marvellous light:
Which in time past were not a people, but r now tha people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
Dearly beloved, I beg u as strangers N pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against tha soul;
Havin ur conversation honest among tha Gentiles: dat, whereas dey speak against u as evildoers, dey may by ur good works, which dey shall look, glorify God in tha day of visitation.
Submit y’all 2 every ordinance of man 4 tha Lord’s sake: whether it be 2 tha king, as supreme;
Or 2 governors, as 2 ’em dat r sent by him 4 tha punishment of evildoers, N 4 tha praise of ’em dat do well.
4 so is tha will of God, dat wit well doin y’all may put 2 silence tha ignorance of foolish men:
As free, N not using ur liberty 4 a cloke of maliciousness, but as tha servants of God.
Honour all men. Love tha brotherhood. Fear God. Honour tha king.
Servants, be subject 2 ur masters wit all fear; not only 2 tha good N gentle, but also 2 tha froward.
4 dis is thankworthy, if a man 4 conscience toward God endure grief, sufferin wrongfully.
4 what glory is it, if, when y’all be buffeted 4 ur faults, y’all shall take it patiently? but if, when y’all do well, N suffer 4 it, y’all take it patiently, dis is acceptable wit God.
4 even hereunto were y’all called: because Christ also suffered 4 us, leavin us an example, dat y’all should follow his steps:
Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself 2 him dat judges righteously:
Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on tha tree, dat we, bein dead 2 sins, should live 2 righteousness: by whose stripes y’all were healed.
4 y’all were as sheep goin astray; but r now returned 2 tha Shepherd N Bishop of ur souls.

3.text: Likewise, y’all wives, be in subjection 2 ur own husbands; dat, if any obey not tha word, dey also may without tha word be won by tha conversation of tha wives;
While dey look ur chaste conversation coupled wit fear.
Whose adorning let it not be dat outward adorning of plaiting tha hair, N of wearing of gold, or of puttin on of clothing;
But let it be tha hidden man of tha heart, in dat which is not corruptible, even tha ornament of a meek N quiet spirit, which is in tha sight of God of great price.
4 after dis manner in tha old time tha holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, bein in subjection 2 their own husbands:
Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, callin him lord: whose daughters y’all r, as long as y’all do well, N r not afraid wit any amazement.
Likewise, y’all husbands, live wit ’em according 2 knowledge, givin honour 2 tha wife, as 2 tha weaker vessel, N as bein heirs together of tha grace of life; dat ur prayers don’t be hindered.
Finally, be y’all all of one mind, havin compassion one of another, love as brothers, be pitiful, be courteous:
Not rendering evil 4 evil, or railing 4 railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowin dat y’all r thereunto called, dat y’all should inherit a blessing.
4 he dat will love life, N see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, N his lips dat dey speak no guile:
Let him eschew evil, N do good; let him seek peace, N ensue it.
4 tha eyes of tha Lord r over tha righteous, N his ears r open 2 their prayers: but tha face of tha Lord is against ’em dat do evil.
N who is he dat will harm u, if y’all be followers of dat which is good?
But N if y’all suffer 4 righteousness’ sake, happy r y’all: N don’t be afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
But sanctify tha Lord God in ur hearts: N be ready always 2 give an answer 2 every man dat asks u a reason of tha hope dat is in u wit meekness N fear:
Havin a good conscience; dat, whereas dey speak evil of u, as of evildoers, dey may be ashamed dat falsely accuse ur good conversation in Christ.
4 it is better, if tha will of God be so, dat y’all suffer 4 well doin, than 4 evil doin.
4 Christ also has once suffered 4 sins, tha just 4 tha unjust, dat he might bring us 2 God, bein put 2 death in tha flesh, but quickened by tha Spirit:
By which also he went N preached 2 tha spirits in prison;
Which sometime were disobedient, when once tha longsuffering of God waited in tha days of Noah, while tha ark was a preparing, in which few, dat is, eight souls were saved by water.
Tha like figure whereunto even baptism does also now save us (not tha puttin away of tha filth of tha flesh, but tha answer of a good conscience toward God,) by tha resurrection of Jesus Christ:
Who is gone in2 heaven, N is on tha right hand of God; angels N authorities N powers bein made subject 2 him.

4.text: Forasmuch then as Christ has suffered 4 us in tha flesh, arm y’all likewise wit tha same mind: 4 he dat has suffered in tha flesh has ceased from sin;
Dat he no longer should live tha rest of his time in tha flesh 2 tha lusts of men, but 2 tha will of God.
4 tha time past of our life may suffice us 2 have wrought tha will of tha Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, N abominable idolatries:
In which dey think it strange dat y’all run not wit ’em 2 tha same excess of riot, speakin evil of u:
Who shall give account 2 him dat is ready 2 judge tha quick N tha dead.
4 4 dis cause was tha gospel preached also 2 ’em dat r dead, dat dey might be judged according 2 men in tha flesh, but live according 2 God in tha spirit.
But tha end of all things is at hand: be y’all therefore sober, N watch 2 prayer.
N above all things have fervent charity among y’all: 4 charity shall cover tha crowd of sins.
Use hospitality one 2 another without grudging.
As every man has received tha gift, even so minister tha same one 2 another, as good stewards of tha manifold grace of God.

If any man speak, let him speak as tha oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of tha ability which God gives: dat God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, 2 whom be praise N dominion 4 ever N ever. Amen.
Beloved, think it not strange concerning tha fiery trial which is 2 try u, as though some strange thing happened 2 u:
But rejoice, since as y’all r partakers of Christ’s sufferings; dat, when his glory shall be revealed, y’all may be glad also wit exceeding joy.
If y’all be reproached 4 tha name of Christ, happy r y’all; 4 tha spirit of glory N of God resteth upon u: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on ur part he is glorified.
But let none of u suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.
Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on dis behalf.
4 tha time is come dat judgment must begin at tha house of God: N if it first begin at us, what shall tha end be of ’em dat obey not tha gospel of God?
N if tha righteous scarcely be saved, where shall tha ungodly N tha sinner appear?
So let ’em dat suffer according 2 tha will of God commit tha keepin of their souls 2 him in well doin, as 2 a faithful Creator.

5.text: Tha elders which r among u I exhort, who am also an elder, N a witness of tha sufferings of Christ, N also a partaker of tha glory dat shall be revealed:
Feed tha flock of God which is among u, takin tha oversight of it, not by constraint, but willingly; not 4 filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
Neither as bein lords over God’s heritage, but bein ensamples 2 tha flock.
N when tha chief Shepherd shall appear, y’all shall receive a crown of glory dat fades not away.
Likewise, y’all younger, submit y’all 2 tha elder. yeah, all of u be subject one 2 another, N be clothed wit humility: 4 God resisteth tha proud, N gives grace 2 tha humble.
Humble y’all therefore under tha mighty hand of God, dat he may exalt u in due time:
Castin all ur care upon him; 4 he cares 4 u.
Be sober, be vigilant; because ur adversary tha devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seekin whom he may devour:
Whom resist stedfast in tha faith, knowin dat tha same afflictions r accomplished in ur brothers dat r in tha world.
But tha God of all grace, who has called us 2 his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after dat y’all have suffered a while, make u perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle u.
2 him be glory N dominion 4 ever N ever. Amen.
By Silvanus, a faithful brother 2 u, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, N testifying dat dis is tha true grace of God in which y’all stand.
Tha church dat is at Babylon, elected together wit u, saluteth u; N so does Marcus my son.
Greet y’all one another wit a kiss of charity. Peace be wit u all dat r in Christ Jesus. Amen.
